title: E010 command-bus rejection confirmed
summary: E011 proved E010 was rejected before project execution with reason MISSING_FIELDS at remote commit 84bd56cf1be7a01f17a377b3ded5a5bac4405206. The E010 inbox object lacks created_at_utc and issuer. Therefore E010 never reached the project executor and cannot be used as evidence about Sol R2 state.
first_incomplete_step: Obtain the Sol R2 classifier through a fresh immutable command with a schema-complete envelope.
next_action: Use a fresh task id; require created_at_utc and issuer in the command envelope; keep the task read-only and do not start a model or advance to Astra until the classifier is observed.
